title: Gymmi AI
lines: A workout journal with AI scheduling
A public student MVP with a private cloud journal

Matan Roditi
AI Development final project

title: From weekly plan to monthly calendar
lines: 01  Add a workout with a date, duration and routine.
02  Mark the workout complete and see weekly progress update.
03  Reload the page to confirm the cloud save.
04  Find the same completed workout in the monthly calendar.
Next, ask AI to reschedule two planned workouts.

title: Progress and the optional league
lines:
100 EXP per completed workout
Mark it in the plan or monthly calendar.

500 EXP per level
Your level uses all completed workouts in your journal.

Optional weekly league
Join with a nickname from a signed-in account.

Weekly standings
The top 20 by EXP, Monday to Sunday in Israel.

title: The browser, the cloud journal and the AI key
lines:
Browser app
The weekly plan and monthly calendar read the same journal.

Supabase
Auth identifies the user.
Postgres stores the journal.
RLS checks ownership.

OpenAI
gpt-5.4-mini proposes weekdays from the user’s availability.
The Supabase Edge Function calls OpenAI. The OpenAI key stays in Supabase Secrets on the server.

title: The schedule stays a preview until approval
lines: 01  Describe which days and times work for you.
02  The server validates the model’s proposal.
03  Compare current and suggested dates. The journal is unchanged.
04  Approve the proposal to save dates to Supabase.

title: One journal in the weekly and monthly views
lines: Select a day to see, add or complete a workout.
Reload and find the same completed workout.
Approved AI dates appear in this calendar after saving.
Optional: open a Google Calendar draft or export an ICS file.

title: Verification on the public app
lines: Before approval, the rehearsal request left the saved dates and journal revision unchanged.
After approval, the new dates survived reload and appeared in the monthly calendar.

title: Git workflow and public deployment
lines: Cursor is the code editor. Git records changes on a feature branch.
A commit records a change. Push uploads it to GitHub for a pull request.
Merge into main publishes docs/ through GitHub Pages. The server function deploys separately.
Real examples: PR #9 adds AI scheduling. PR #16 redesigns the interface.

title: Workout planning and scheduling
lines: The weekly plan tracks completed workouts and progress.
The monthly calendar shows workouts from the same cloud journal.
AI suggests new dates for planned workouts.
The user approves each proposal before the dates are saved.

title: Scope and current limits
lines: Production: public HTTPS app, GitHub source and cloud accounts.
AI: an existing language model proposes dates; the user reviews and approves.
Calendar: Google drafts and ICS export. Automatic sync awaits Google OAuth setup.
Weekly competition uses self-reported workout completions.
MVP limits: unverified emails, no password recovery and capped AI requests.
